resources.string: A modernised rootless Xposed framework manager and APK patching utility.

ShimmerPatch injects the Xposed loader by modifying APK files. Local mode works with the manager to load modules and manage scopes dynamically, without keeping the manager running in the background. Integrated mode embeds modules directly into the target app for standalone use on devices without the manager. Shizuku only unlocks some convenience features and is not required for ShimmerPatch core patching, module loading, or basic management.
Please configure the necessary system permissions to ensure ShimmerPatch functions correctly.
Required for reading source APKs and exporting patched binaries to your device.
Allows ShimmerPatch to retrieve installed applications for accurate patching target selection.
Before patching apps or loading Xposed modules, make sure you understand the following risks.

Patching applications may lead to instability, data corruption, or compatibility failures. Ensure critical data is backed up. You are solely responsible for the conduct of patched apps and modules on your device.
